children: The CBOT soybean November contract (SX26) may test support at $12.96-3/4 per bushel, a break below which could trigger a fall into $12.84 to $12.92 range.

A death cross formed on the hourly MACD, confirming an exhaustion of the rally. This bearish signal works together with the possible completion of a five-wave cycle from $12.16-1/4, to suggest a further correction.
The territory of the wave d is between $12.79-1/4 to $12.92, which serves as a target range. Resistance is at $13.09-1/2, a break above which may lead to a gain to $13.17-1/4 to $13.25-1/4 range.
On the daily chart, a projection analysis on the rise from $12.65-1/4 reveals a resistance of $13.19-1/4, the 114.6% level, which triggered a correction.
A channel technique indicates a target around $12.81-1/4, assuming the correction is the same degree as the one from the August 20 high of $12.44-1/2.
